# Marian Stancik

> Personal brand website, technical knowledge graph, and autonomous multi-agent engineering hub of Marian Stancik — AI Engineer, UAV Builder, Law Scholar (PF UK), and CEO @ ASCENTIA.

- [About](https://www.marianstancik.dev/about): Technical bio, 4-layer engineering stack (Hetzner VPS, OpenRouter, Obsidian, Zero-build Web), and career timeline.
- [Expertise](https://www.marianstancik.dev/expertise): Detailed spec matrices across 3 core pillars: Autonomous AI Agents, Law & AI Compliance, and UAV Edge AI Systems.
- [AI Engineering Skills](https://www.marianstancik.dev/skills): Full-stack skills taxonomy covering Build & Deploy AI, Software Engineering, LLM & Agentive Systems, and Production Operations.
- [Tactical UAV Systems](https://www.marianstancik.dev/drones): Hand-soldered 1500g carbon quadcopter, ArduPilot Copter autopilot, Raspberry Pi 5 edge vision AI, and flight logs.
- [Blog](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog): Technical articles on autonomous AI workflows, legal-by-design compliance (AI Act, GDPR), and robotics.
- [Contact](https://www.marianstancik.dev/contact): Direct lead capture, communication channels, and social profiles.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Search Engines

### Q: Who is Marian Stancik?
A: Marian Stancik is an AI Engineer, UAV Builder, and Law Scholar (3rd year at Faculty of Law, Comenius University in Bratislava — PF UK). He builds production multi-agent systems (Hermes Agent, MCP), hand-soldered tactical drones (ArduPilot, Raspberry Pi 5 edge vision AI), and legal-by-design compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR, NIS2, DORA).

### Q: What is Hermes Agent and how does Marian Stancik use it?
A: Hermes Agent is an autonomous agent execution framework. Marian runs Hermes Agent 24/7 on an enterprise Hetzner Cloud VPS, interfacing with custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, utilizing OpenRouter for multi-model dynamic routing (DeepSeek, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o), with persistent memory managed in an Obsidian knowledge vault and live Command & Control via Telegram and WhatsApp.

### Q: What infrastructure powers Marian's autonomous agents?
A: Dedicated Linux Ubuntu VPS hosted in Hetzner Cloud (Nuremberg and Helsinki data centers), ensuring strict EU data sovereignty. The stack consists of Python 3, FastAPI, Caddy reverse proxy, SQLite, 19+ cron orchestrations, Obsidian Markdown second brain for memory, and zero-build Vanilla HTML5/CSS3/JS for high-performance interfaces (Lighthouse 100).

### Q: What is Marian's legal background in AI compliance?
A: 3rd-year law student at Faculty of Law, Comenius University in Bratislava (PF UK), specializing in legal-by-design frameworks: EU AI Act (risk tiering, GPAI governance, technical files), GDPR (training data privacy), NIS2 Directive (cyber resilience), DORA (financial digital endurance), EU Data Act, and DSM Copyright Directive (TDM exemptions).

### Q: What are the technical specs of Marian's tactical UAV build?
A: A custom 1500g carbon tactical quadcopter with an 8-inch GEPRC Mark4 frame, Skystars H7 Dual Gyro FC, AM60 60A ESC stack, iFlight XING2 2809 1250Kv motors, 6S 5500mAh LiPo, RadioMaster ELRS telemetry, and FlyfishRC GNSS. It runs ArduPilot Copter autopilot software with an onboard Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB) companion computer and Camera Module 3 for real-time edge vision AI target detection. Licensed EASA A1/A3 with €2.6M Coverdrone insurance.

### Q: What is ASCENTIA?
A: ASCENTIA is an agent-native proof-of-concept organization model built to test end-to-end business automation powered 100% by autonomous AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling, and 24/7 scheduled workflows.
